llms.body:
# Fluid Player

> Fluid Player, the VAST ready free and open source HTML5 video player.

Fluid Player (https://www.fluidplayer.com/) is a free, open source (MIT) HTML5 video player, sponsored by EXOGROUP (https://www.exogroup.com/). It supports VAST and VPAID video ads, HLS and MPEG-DASH streaming, VR, subtitles and timeline previews, and works with Vue.js, React and Angular.

## Links

- Documentation: https://docs.fluidplayer.com/
- Source code: https://github.com/fluid-player/fluid-player
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/fluid-player
- WordPress plugin: https://wordpress.org/plugins/fluid-player/

## Pages

- [FAQ](https://www.fluidplayer.com/faq/)
- [Blog](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/)
- [Free tools](https://www.fluidplayer.com/tools/)
- [SRT to VTT Converter](https://www.fluidplayer.com/tools/srt-to-vtt-converter/): Convert SRT subtitles to WebVTT for HTML5 video in your browser. Fixes broken accents, checks for errors and previews the result. Free, no upload.
- [VTT to SRT Converter](https://www.fluidplayer.com/tools/vtt-to-srt-converter/): Convert WebVTT subtitles to SRT in your browser, for YouTube and video editors. Keeps positions, checks for errors and previews the result. Free, no upload.
- [HLS & DASH Stream Tester](https://www.fluidplayer.com/tools/hls-stream-tester/): Test HLS (.m3u8) and DASH (.mpd) streams in your browser: play them, see quality levels and codecs, and find out why a stream fails, CORS errors included. Free.
- [VAST Tag Tester & Validator](https://www.fluidplayer.com/tools/vast-tag-tester/): Test a VAST tag or VAST XML in your browser: follow every wrapper, validate against VAST 2.0–4.3 and VMAP, and play the ad in Fluid Player. Free, nothing sent.
- [VAST Error Codes](https://www.fluidplayer.com/tools/vast-error-codes/): Every VAST error code from 100 to 902 in plain words: what it means, common causes and how to fix it, including 303, 301, 402 and 403. VAST 2.0 to 4.3.

## Blog

- [New: a free VAST Tag Tester that follows every wrapper and shows every ad event](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/vast-tag-tester/): Our new free tool follows every wrapper of a VAST tag, explains each problem in plain words with its error code, and plays the ad in Fluid Player.
- [New: a free HLS & DASH Stream Tester that tells you why a stream fails](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/hls-dash-stream-tester/): Our new free tool plays your .m3u8 or .mpd stream, shows its quality levels and codecs, and names the file that fails, with the fix. In your browser.
- [SRT or VTT? Which subtitle format each platform accepts](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/srt-or-vtt-subtitle-formats/): SRT or VTT? See which subtitle format YouTube, Vimeo, LinkedIn, Premiere Pro, Canvas and HTML5 video accept, and convert your files for free in your browser.
- [HTML video player comparison: Fluid Player vs. Shaka Player](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/fluidplayer-vs-shaka-player/): Fluid Player and Shaka Player, two free and open source HTML5 video players, compared side by side: video ads, streaming, player features, setup and support.
- [HTML video player comparison: Fluid Player vs. MediaElement.js](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/fluidplayer-vs-mediaelement/): MediaElement.js is the video player built into WordPress. We compare it with Fluid Player: video ads, streaming, player features, setup and support.
- [A new Fluid Player website, and a Player Builder with every setting](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/new-fluid-player-website-and-player-builder/): The Fluid Player website has a new look, and the Player Builder now covers every player option: over 100 settings, a live preview and code ready to copy.
- [HTML video player comparison: Fluid Player vs. Flowplayer](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/fluidplayer-vs-flowplayer/): Fluid Player and Flowplayer compared: price, license, video ads, streaming, features, setup and support. Find the right HTML5 video player for your site.
- [YouTube embed or your own video player? Fluid Player vs. YouTube](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/fluidplayer-vs-youtube/): Should you embed your videos from YouTube or play them in your own player? Revenue, control, search traffic, speed and hosting, compared honestly.
- [How to add a React video player with VAST ads](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/react-video-player-with-ads/): Build a React video player with VAST ads using Fluid Player, free and open source: a reusable component, pre-roll and mid-roll ads, HLS and TypeScript.
- [Free HTML video players compared: Fluid Player vs. Video.js](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/fluidplayer-vs-videojs/): Fluid Player and Video.js compared side by side: video ads, streaming, player features, setup and support. Find the right free HTML5 video player for your site.
- [HTML video player comparison: Fluid Player vs. JW Player](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/fluidplayer-vs-jwplayer/): Fluid Player and JW Player compared: price, video ads, streaming, player features, setup and support. Find the right HTML5 video player for your site.
- [Publishers! Meet Fluid Player: The lightweight free online video player](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/fluidplayer-101-publishers/): Everything you need to know about Fluid Player and how to use it as your video player to monetize your video content with industry standard video advertising.
- [New Feature: Subtitles in VTT file format for Publisher Sites!](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/subtitles-in-vtt-file-format-fluidplayer/): Fluid Player has recently launched a new feature enabling subtitles on Publisher Sites’ video content, available using a VTT file format.
- [Fluid player new update! Live stream video ads](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/fluid-player-new-update-live-stream-video-ads/): Ever since YouTube LIVE and Twitch, live stream video ads have become extremely popular to promote brands.
- [Fluid Player updated to Version 3](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/fluidplayer-updated-v3/): Fluid Player, the free, open-source, HTML5 video player has been updated to version 3.
- [Fluid Player adds VR and VPAID features](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/fluid-player-vr-vpaid/): Fluid Player, the free, open-source, HTML5 video player has released two new features: VR (virtual reality) support and VPAID (video player ad-serving…
- [Fluid Player master class #1: how to use the Player Builder](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/fluid-player-master-class-1-how-to-use-the-builder/): If you are not an expert in writing code, this Master Class will show you how to use the Fluid Player Builder, which allows you to edit some of its key…
- [Top 5 HTML video players](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/top-5-html-video-players/): Online video advertising is one of the biggest growth areas in digital advertising, check out the statistics: 'Understanding the Expanding Benefits of…
- [3 easy steps to integrate in-stream advertising with Fluid Player](https://www.fluidplayer.com/blog/easy-in-stream-integration-on-fluid-player/): ExoClick’s in-stream video ad format works with all major HTML5 video players.

Free open source
HTML5 video player

Video ads, streaming and VR, under the MIT license.

Try our Player Builder
  • 960+ GitHub stars (opens in a new tab)
  • 80K+ npm downloads a year (opens in a new tab)
  • 38 Open source contributors (opens in a new tab)
  • 10+ Years of active development

Overview

  • Compatible with video advertising industry standards VAST (opens in a new tab) and VPAID (opens in a new tab)

  • Integrate our WordPress Plugin (opens in a new tab) and CDN hosted player (opens in a new tab)

  • Enables easy manipulation (opens in a new tab) of a number of properties after initialization

  • Video streaming support for MPEG-DASH and HLS streaming (opens in a new tab) protocols

  • VR support (opens in a new tab)

  • Support for dynamic frontend frameworks (opens in a new tab) including Vue.js, React and Angular

Player Builder

Use the builder to see how easy it is to customize Fluid Player while seeing your changes in real time in the video player, then switch to Code, copy the generated code and paste it into your website.

Code to paste in your website

HTML
<script src="https://cdn.fluidplayer.com/v3/current/fluidplayer.min.js"></script>
<video id="video-id"><source src="video.mp4" type="video/mp4" /></video>
<script>
    var myFP = fluidPlayer('video-id');
</script>

Player options

Video

Prefilled with our demo video (Spring). Timeline thumbnails and subtitles of the demo only apply to it.

The video to play: MP4, WebM, HLS (.m3u8) or DASH (.mpd). Paste your own to try it; the preview loads it from your browser.
Playback
Sets the preload attribute of the video: how much of the file the browser loads before the viewer presses play.
Control bar
s
Comma-separated, from fastest to slowest.
In % or px.
In % or px.

px 400 px or more: Fluid Player ignores smaller values.
px 225 px or more: Fluid Player ignores smaller values.
vw Share of the screen width, 40 to 100.
Viewer features
Right-click menu
Remember viewer choices

Kept in the viewer's browser between visits.

Look
Shows a title on the video. Disabled by default.
12 px
Rounds the corners of the player (border radius, in px). 0 by default in Fluid Player; 12 px preset here.
Any CSS color, e.g. #1e88e5 or red (anything else is ignored). It colors the play button shown before the video plays, the play and pause animations, the played progress bar and the user-defined ad text.
Icons are images: they are restyled with CSS (added to the code to copy). “Your own images” adds a CSS template to fill in.
Poster image
Demo file max size: 2 MB. The image stays on your computer: it is only shown in this preview.

The demo file size must be lower than 2 MB.

Words of the right-click menu (play, mute, full screen...), e.g. to translate them. Empty = default. The button tooltips can't be changed in Fluid Player 3.61.

Ads

Pre-filled with our demo ad. Replace it with your own VAST URL to test your ads.

Seconds (e.g. 10) or a share of the video (e.g. 50%).

Shown on in-stream ads, in the primary color.
[seconds] is replaced by the countdown.

Tried for every ad when its own VAST URL fails (fallbackVastTags).

These add ready-to-fill code to the snippet. They do nothing in the preview.

From the blog

  • New: a free VAST Tag Tester & Validator

    Product newsNov 22, 20265 min read

    Paste a VAST tag or its XML: the new Fluid Player VAST Tag Tester follows every wrapper, checks each step against the VAST specification, tells you what’s wrong in plain words and plays the ad, with every event it reports. Free, no account, in your browser.

    Read post →

  • New: a free HLS & DASH Stream Tester

    Product newsNov 18, 20264 min read

    Paste an .m3u8 or .mpd address: the new Fluid Player Stream Tester plays it, shows what’s inside, checks every kind of request and tells you in plain words which file fails and how to fix it. Free, no account, and it runs in your browser.

    Read post →

  • SRT or VTT? The subtitle format each platform accepts

    GuidesNov 17, 202611 min read

    YouTube, LinkedIn, Premiere Pro, Canvas, your own website: each one wants its subtitles in a certain format. Here is which one, checked on each platform’s own help pages, plus fixes for out-of-sync subtitles and broken accents, and our two new free converters.

    Read post →
